panel.title: Your Codexa workspace
panel.description: Your account, your team and the official Codexa plugins, in one place.

signIn.title: One secure sign in
signIn.description: Codexa OAuth signs you in, and the app never sees your password.

workspace.title: Built for your team
workspace.description: Accounts, roles and access stay organised as your team grows.

plugins.title: Official plugins in one hub
plugins.description: Every official Codexa plugin is managed from here.

common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the value and copy it by hand.

session.title: Session
session.description: What OAuth reports about this sign in.

user.accountFailed: Could not open your account. Please try again.
user.switchFailed: Could not switch account. Please try again.

account.title: Session
account.description: Your signed in session, and signing out.
account.signOutDescription: This ends the session in every tab that shares it. You can sign in again at any time.
account.signOutFailed: You are signed out here, but the server could not be told. The session ends when it expires.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Continue to your Codexa dashboard with your Codexa account.
signIn.notConfigured: Sign in is not configured yet. Set CODEXA_APP_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID on the host.

failure.failed: Sign in could not be completed. Please try again.
failure.state: This sign in link is no longer valid. Please start again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.emptyDescription: Add your own pages and widgets in src/overrides/routes.tsx. Your session details are in the profile menu.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist or has moved.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.description: This page could not be loaded. Reloading usually fixes it.

search.title: Search screens
search.description: Find any page you can open.

users.title: Users
users.description: Everyone who can sign in to this app.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who belong to this account, and their roles.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Roles group permissions to assign to members.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Who is signed in to this account, and where.

consents.title: Consents
consents.description: Which apps people allowed to access their data.

archive.label: Archive
archive.title: Archive this?
archive.description: It stops working straight away. Its history is kept.

remove.label: Remove
remove.title: Remove this member?
remove.description: They lose access to this account straight away.

revoke.label: Revoke
revoke.title: Revoke this?
revoke.description: It stops working straight away and cannot be undone.

revokeCredential.label: Revoke
revokeCredential.title: Revoke this credential?
revokeCredential.description: Apps using this client ID stop signing in straight away. This cannot be undone.

form.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that. You can only give, change or remove access you hold yourself.
form.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
form.noMatchCreate: No matches. Type a new value to add it.
form.cannotAdd: Use letters, numbers and colons, such as invoices:approve.

validation.url: Enter full URLs starting with https:// or http://, one per line.
validation.roleKey: Start with a lowercase letter, then lowercase letters, numbers, "-" or "_", up to 50.
validation.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and "-", up to 60.
validation.conditionField: Use a context and a field, such as account.type.
validation.pickPermission: Allow or deny at least one permission.
validation.color: Use a six digit hex colour, such as #16a34a.
validation.imageUrl: Enter a full image URL starting with https:// or http://.
validation.radius: Enter a whole number from 0 to 24.
validation.font: Use letters, numbers, spaces, commas, quotes and "-".

accounts.createDescription: A team, department or project inside this workspace.
accounts.slugHint: Used in links. It cannot change later.
accounts.activeHint: An inactive account cannot be signed in to.
accounts.parentHint: The account this one sits under. Accounts nest a limited number of levels.

users.statusHint: Suspended and banned users cannot sign in.

members.activeHint: An inactive member keeps their place but cannot use this account.

invites.createDescription: They get an email with a link to join this account.
invites.sentDescription: An email is on its way to {{email}}. You can also share this link. Only the account with that email can accept it.

roles.createDescription: A role names a set of people. Policies decide what it may do.
roles.keyHint: The name policies and code use. It cannot change later.
roles.assignableHint: Whether people can be given this role when invited or edited.
roles.activeHint: An inactive role cannot be given, and its people lose its access.

policies.createDescription: Grant or deny permissions to roles, members or everyone.
policies.allowHint: Pick or type permissions, such as invoices:approve. "*" allows everything.
policies.denyHint: A deny always wins over an allow, from any policy.
policies.priorityHint: Lower numbers are checked first. It never lets an allow beat a deny.
policies.accountHint: Everyone who belongs to these accounts.
policies.whoDescription: The roles, members or accounts this policy applies to.
policies.whatDescription: Allow or deny each permission. A deny always wins, from any policy.
policies.whenDescription: Optional rules that must hold, and the window the policy is active in.

applications.createDescription: An app people sign in to, with the credential it signs in with.
applications.aboutDescription: The name people see when they sign in and approve access.
applications.signInDescription: Its first credential. You can add more later from the application's page.

credentials.createDescription: A client ID an app uses to sign people in, or to call the API itself.

kindHints.browser: A browser or phone app. It signs people in with PKCE and holds no secret.
kindHints.server: A backend that signs people in. It gets a secret it must keep private.
kindHints.machine: A service calling the API as itself, with a secret, acting as one member.
kindHints.device: A device without a browser. People approve it with a code on another screen.

credentials.actsAsHint: OAuth creates a service identity for this key in this account, with this role. The key gets exactly that role's access, and you can only pick a role whose access you hold.
credentials.consentHint: People approve the requested access the first time they sign in.
credentials.name: Credential name
credentials.nameHint: For you, to tell its credentials apart.
credentials.scopesHint: Pick or type the scopes it may ask for.

branding.title: Branding
branding.identityHint: Shown on every sign in page and in the dashboard.
branding.darkLogoHint: Used in dark mode. Without it the logo above is used.
branding.fontHint: A font installed on the device, such as Inter. The app's own font is used when it is missing.
branding.themeHint: Leave a colour empty to keep the app's own.

application.description: An app people sign in to, and its credentials.
application.credentialsDescription: Each client ID that signs in to this app, and how.
application.rotateDescription: A new secret is made and the old one stops working straight away.
application.secretDescription: It is shown only once. Store it somewhere safe, such as your server's secret manager.
application.issuedDescription: Use this client ID in the app's sign in settings.
application.secretWarning: It is shown only this once. Store it in your server's secret manager.
application.revokedNote: This credential is revoked. It can never sign in again, so it has no actions.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.heading: You cannot open this page
forbidden.description: Your role does not include it. Ask an administrator of this account for access.

missing.title: Not found
missing.heading: This item no longer exists
missing.description: It may have been removed or archived, or the link is wrong.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.heading: This page could not load
failed.description: Check your connection and try again.

details.description: Everything about this record, and what you can do with it.

conditions.always: No conditions. The policy always applies while it is active.
conditions.tooDeep: This condition was written with more nesting than the editor shows. It is kept exactly as it is when you save.

rootHints.credential: The client that got the token
rootHints.request: The call itself: method, path and time
rootHints.resource: The record acted on, such as a post
rootHints.environment: Other values your route passes in

rootHelp.user: Fields of the signed in person, such as id, username or attributes.department.
rootHelp.account: Fields of the current account, such as type, isActive or attributes.plan.
rootHelp.collaborator: The person's membership, such as isOwner or attributes.team.
rootHelp.role: The person's role in this account, such as name.
rootHelp.session: The session, such as authMethod, which is password, passkey, magic_link or sso.
rootHelp.app: The application, such as name or attributes.region.
rootHelp.credential: The client the token was issued to, such as name or type.
rootHelp.request: The call itself: method such as GET, path such as /api/posts, or timestamp in milliseconds.
rootHelp.resource: The record your route checks, which its guard passes in. Name the field as it is on the record, such as title or ownerId, not the collection. The permission says which kind of record it is, such as posts:update. To let only owners act, compare ownerId with the field session.user.
rootHelp.environment: Anything else your route passes in, such as country or deviceType.

device.title: Connect a device
device.description: Approve a TV, console or command line that shows you a code.
device.enterDescription: Type the code your device shows.
device.accessIntro: It asks for this access. Leave out anything you do not want to give.
device.approvedDescription: You can go back to your device. It signs in by itself.
device.deniedDescription: The device was not signed in.
device.invalidDescription: It may be mistyped or expired. Ask the device for a new one.
device.unavailableDescription: This server does not offer sign in with a device code.
device.failed: That did not work. The code may have expired.

providers.title: Sign in providers
providers.description: Let people sign in to this app with an account they already have, such as Google. Your host decides which providers are offered.
providers.noneDescription: The host has not approved a sign in provider for this app.
providers.removeDescription: Its button leaves the sign in page. People already linked keep their link and can sign in again once you add it back.
providers.name: Button name
providers.nameHint: Shown on the sign in page, as in “Continue with Google”.
providers.enabledHint: When off, its button is hidden and nobody can sign in with it.
providers.registrationHint: When off, only people who already have an account here can use it.
providers.registrationLocked: The host does not let this provider create accounts, so only existing people can use it.
